tracepcap-frontend.name: viewer
tracepcap-frontend.description: TracePcap viewer: reads captures, networks, findings and reports. What each role may do is set in TracePcap (Settings > Permissions). Assign to a group: Groups > the group > Role mapping > Assign role > Filter by clients.

tracepcap-frontend.name: analyst
tracepcap-frontend.description: TracePcap analyst: investigates (upload, ask the AI, label, override, capture and network rules). What each role may do is set in TracePcap (Settings > Permissions). Assign to a group: Groups > the group > Role mapping > Assign role > Filter by clients.

tracepcap-frontend.name: lead
tracepcap-frontend.description: TracePcap lead: curates what everyone shares (global rules, address defaults, network settings, anyone's captures, the audit log). What each role may do is set in TracePcap (Settings > Permissions). Assign to a group: Groups > the group > Role mapping > Assign role > Filter by clients.

tracepcap-frontend.name: admin
tracepcap-frontend.description: TracePcap admin: every permission, always, including changing roles. What each role may do is set in TracePcap (Settings > Permissions). Assign to a group: Groups > the group > Role mapping > Assign role > Filter by clients.
